items.html: There is yet a third light, surrounding both of them, and it is also HaVaYaH in the filling of Yodin, Yod-Yod, Hey-Yod, Vav-Yod-Vav, Hey-Yod. However, the manner of the vocalization is: in the simple letters, they are vocalized in the manner of the movement of the letters — Cholam, Tzere, Kamatz, Tzere — and the six other letters of the filling are all vocalized with a Kamatz beneath each of them.
